timeline.text_en: Samsung HBM4 quoted at ~$4~5 per Gb, ~3x HBM3E; HBM will consume ~30% of global DRAM wafer capacity; Micron warns 2027/2028 supply-demand will be tighter than 2026; handset memory spot prices up 300%+ cumulatively over the past 3 months

timeline.text_en: Huaqiangbei memory spot prices up 300%+ in a year (DDR4 16G from RMB 100+ to 600+, DDR5 16G from RMB 200+ to over 1,400; Shenzhen Media Group / Jiemian, Oct 7~8); TrendForce expects Q4 handset DRAM/NAND contract prices +10%~20% (Oct 8); Richard Yu acknowledged per-device memory cost is up by over US$200, making price increases unavoidable

timeline.change: 高盛预计 2027 年四大云 capex 近 1.14 万亿美元；制约转向电力与并网，PJM 称 2026/27–2028/29 预测数据中心需求增长的 42% 已延期或取消

events.title: 美国对加Section 338清单调整：空调新纳入50%加征范围
events.title_en: US revises Canada Section 338 list: air conditioners newly subject to 50% duties

timeline.change: 特朗普10-23签署公告调整对加Section 338清单：胶合板、部分工业机械与包装纸品10-30起移出50%加征范围，空调新纳入加征范围；加拿大原产空调10-30起面临50%关税（另有诉讼挑战该措施合法性）（Supply Chain Dive，10-23）
timeline.text_en: Trump signed a proclamation on Oct 23 revising the Canada Section 338 list: plywood, some industrial machinery and packaging paper exit the 50% duties from Oct 30, while air conditioners are newly added; Canada-origin air conditioners face 50% duties from Oct 30 (a lawsuit challenges the measure's legality) (Supply Chain Dive, Oct 23)

timeline.change: 10-23特朗普签署公告、10-30生效：部分制冷设备移出50%加征清单（部分阀门加回）；涉加采购需按最新HTS编码核对。
timeline.text_en: Trump proclamation signed 10-23, effective 10-30: some refrigeration equipment removed from the 50% additional-tariff list (some valves added back); Canada-sourced procurement must verify latest HTS codes.

timeline.change: 新增窗式空调等HVAC品类：特朗普10-23签署修订公告（修订Proclamation 11048），window air conditioners、铁/钢阀（8481.80.30）等100个税号自10-30美东0:01起纳入50% Section 338关税（USMCA原产不豁免、可叠加232；22个税号移出）
timeline.text_en: Added window air conditioners and other HVAC items: Oct-23 revised proclamation (amending Proclamation 11048) puts 100 HTS lines including window air conditioners and iron/steel valves (8481.80.30) under 50% Section 338 tariffs effective Oct-30 00:01 ET (no USMCA exemption, stackable with Section 232; 22 lines removed)

timeline.change: 10-23特朗普签署公告第三次修订清单，10-30 00:01（美东）生效：空调设备/阀门/地毯/卧式冷冻柜新增50%从价关税，部分机械制冷设备移出；USMCA原产商品不豁免、可与232条款叠加。
timeline.text_en: Trump signed the third revision on Oct 23, effective 12:01 a.m. ET Oct 30: 50% ad-valorem duties added on air conditioners, valves, carpets and horizontal freezers; some mechanical refrigeration equipment removed. USMCA-origin goods not exempt; can stack with Section 232.

events.status_note: 10-30新版清单生效：阀门新纳入50%加征范围，冷冻设备等移出

timeline.change: 距暂停到期5天。2025-10-09六项公告（55/56/57/58/61/62号，含0.1%域外规则）暂停至2026-11-10；商务部9-28称中美休战延至2027-01-10但声明未点名稀土；截至10-16商务部公告清单无延长70号公告的文本。2025-04-04第18号公告7种重稀土从未暂停、持续生效，许可证审查约4个月；8月稀土出口量同比-18.2%。
timeline.text_en: Five days to the pause expiry. The six Oct 9 2025 announcements (Nos. 55/56/57/58/61/62, incl. the 0.1% extraterritorial rule) were suspended until Nov 10 2026; MOFCOM said Sep 28 the US-China truce runs to Jan 10 2027 but did not name rare earths; as of Oct 16 no text extending Announcement No. 70 appeared in MOFCOM notices. The Apr 4 2025 Announcement No. 18 (7 heavy rare earths) was never suspended and stays in force, with license reviews taking ~4 months; August rare-earth exports fell 18.2% YoY.

timeline.change: 距11-10暂停到期剩4天，截至11-05仍无续期法律文本；商务部9-28称中美休战延至2027-01-10但未点名稀土、未修订第70号公告。氧化镨钕11-05报711,000元/吨（+10,000），10月下旬下行后小幅回稳。
timeline.text_en: Four days left until the Nov 10 suspension expiry; as of Nov 5 no renewal legal text exists. MOFCOM said on Sep 28 the truce extends to Jan 10, 2027 but did not name rare earths or amend Notice No. 70. Praseodymium-neodymium oxide was 711,000 yuan/t on Nov 5 (+10,000), stabilizing after a late-October slide.

timeline.change: 截至 11-06 仍无修订第 70 号公告的法律文本，剩 3 天；贝森特称釜山休战覆盖稀土、延至 2027-01-10，但未见正式文本；氧化镨钕 11-05 报 711,000 元/吨（+10,000）
timeline.text_en: As of Nov 6, still no legal text amending Announcement No. 70, 3 days left; Bessent says the Busan truce covers rare earths through Jan 10, 2027, but no formal text seen; praseodymium-neodymium oxide quoted 711,000 yuan/t on Nov 5 (+10,000)

timeline.change: 11-06 美财长贝森特与 USTR 格里尔同何立峰视频通话，要求中方立即全面落实釜山承诺、重点点名稀土；美方称中方仅履行约三分之二稀土承诺（FT 9 月口径转述）；第 70 号公告法定到期日仍为 11-10，未见修订文本；氧化镨钕 11-06 均价 707,500 元/吨（-3,500）
timeline.text_en: On Nov 6 Bessent and Greer spoke with He Lifeng by video, urging China to fully implement the Busan commitments immediately, singling out rare earths; the US side said China has fulfilled only about two-thirds of its rare-earth pledges (FT September wording, as relayed); Announcement No. 70 still legally expires Nov 10 with no amendment text; praseodymium-neodymium oxide averaged 707,500 yuan/t on Nov 6 (-3,500)

timeline.change: 截至 11-09 上午仍无修订第 70 号公告的法律文本；商务部 11-06 回应仅确认暂停至 11-10；氧化镨钕 11-06 均价 707,500 元/吨（-3,500）
timeline.text_en: As of the morning of Nov 9, still no legal text amending Announcement No. 70; MOFCOM said on Nov 6 only that the suspension runs to Nov 10; praseodymium-neodymium oxide averaged RMB 707,500/t on Nov 6 (-3,500)

timeline.change: 商务部 11-09 宣布暂停期延至 2027-01-10：六项 2025-10-09 公告（55-58 号、61-62 号）11-11 至 2027-01-10 继续暂停；4 月七种中重稀土许可制从未暂停、持续生效；美方 11-06 曾称中方仅履行约三分之二釜山稀土承诺
timeline.text_en: MOFCOM announced on Nov 9 the pause is extended to Jan 10, 2027: the six Oct 9, 2025 announcements stay suspended Nov 11, 2026-Jan 10, 2027; the April 2025 licensing regime for seven medium-heavy rare earths was never suspended; on Nov 6 the US side said China had met only about two-thirds of its Busan rare-earth commitments
